thread:
tess: FYI p99 jump on prod after the model onboarding merge (PR #3589). Started ~8m post-merge, correlates with batch shape churn and KV hit drop.
omar: link to traces/grafana?
tess: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/serving/prod_latency?var-model=prod-Y
omar: p50 steady, p99 moved 160ms -> 640ms. batch_shape_variance spiked and kv_hit_rate fell from 0.95 -> 0.6 around same time.
liam: do we have kernel selector logs? might be choosing safe_sparse_matmul instead of the fast tiled kernel when shapes vary.
anika: I pulled a node profile where the spike originated:
```
[2026-04-02T07:12:11Z] model=prod-Y ckpt=ckpt-20260330 kernel=fast_tiled fallback=safe_sparse_matmul
observed_batch_shapes: [[1,12],[1,8],[1,64]]
avg_tokens: 34 p50:140 p99:640
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.61
kernel_choice_reason: batch_shape_entropy > threshold || tokenizer_prefix_mismatch
```
liam: tokenizer_prefix_mismatch suggests tokenization changed prefixes or offset behavior so cached KV keys don't match. nidhi, did the tokenizer proto change in the onboard?
nidhi: yes, PR #3589 updated byte_offset normalization and switched to unicode_nfkc + new salt. We intended normalization but I did not preserve the kv_salt.
tess: that would explain KV evictions and many cold cache lookups, plus more variable sequence lengths because tokenization now splits differently -> batch scheduler sees more heterogenous shapes -> selector prefers fallback kernel.
omar: staging CI picked this up earlier: perf-ci job 2026-04-02_00 failed p99 and kv hit threshold. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/20260402/3042
anika: quick repro on local: run small synthetic workload with both ckpts, see hit rate delta. I attached the script in the job.
liam: mitigation options (fast -> slow):
- revert the tokenizer salt/normalization in runtime (hotfix revert)
- pin prod to previous checkpoint and stop rollout
- implement compatibility mode: compute legacy kv_salt alongside new and accept either for cache lookup (safer but needs code change)
- add a targeted cache-warmup job to populate new prefixes (temporary)
tess: immediate plan: pin prod to previous model version and hold rollout. I'll open a rollback for the runtime tokenizer change so production isn't affected while we patch onboarding.
idhI: (typo fix) nidhi: I'll prepare a compat-mode patch and tests; also add an onboarding migration that regenerates kv keys for the new salt before rollout.
omar: can we add a lightweight perf assertion to CI that fires on tokenization-sensitive changes? e.g., run small synthetic workload and assert kv_hit_rate >= 0.9 and p99 < 300ms.
liam: yep I'll add perf unit that runs in the perf smoke stage (cheap). Also add a kernel-selection unit that asserts the selector picks fast_tiled for baseline shapes.
anika: assigning follow-ups:
- tess: pin prod + open runtime revert PR + create monitor alert for kv_hit_rate < 0.85 on any rollout
- nidhi: compat-mode PR + onboarding migration + doc on tokenizer->kv compatibility
- liam: CI perf assertion + selector unit test
- anika: run cache warmup job and measure improvement in staging

deploy-bot: Rollback request submitted: https://git.internal/r/engine/commit/cb9d4e. Staging rollback scheduled at 09:10 UTC.
tess: rolling back now and will re-run perf job. If staging p99 returns to baseline we'll proceed to pin prod.
omar: once rollback verified, coordinate with nidhi for a coordinated re-onboard with migration and CI guards.
liam: one more ask -- add an entry to the rollout checklist: any tokenizer change requires explicit kv compatibility verification + perf smoke.
nidhi: sorry about the outage, I'll own the follow-up and draft the compat plan.
tess: ETA for prod stable: ~2.5h after rollback + verification. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
